Here is the pseudocode.
%The text below shows how to write a pseudocode

\newcommand{\cmin}{\mathsf{curr\_min}}
    
\begin{algorithm}[H]
  \caption{Finding the smallest element in an array}
  \label{alg:minfind}
  \begin{algorithmic}[1]

  \Statex \textbf{Input:} Array $A$ of $n$ integers, given by $(A[1],\ldots, A[n])$
\Statex \textbf{Output:} $\min(A):=$ the element with minimum value in $A$  
  \State $\cmin \gets A[1]$ \Comment{initialize $\cmin$ to first element}
  \For{$i=2$ to $n$}:
  \If{$A[i]<\cmin$}: \Comment{If $A[i]$ is smaller than the current smallest}
  \State $\cmin \gets A[i]$ \Comment{reset $\cmin$ to $A[i]$}
\EndIf
  \EndFor
  \State \Return $\cmin$
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
\end{solution}
